label: Cloudflare
agentGuide: Base /client/v4; answers are {success, result, errors}. Zones: GET /zones?name=example.com (id, status, name_servers); DNS: GET /zones/<zone>/dns_records?type=A&name=www.example.com; add: POST /zones/<zone>/dns_records {"type": "A", "name": "www", "content": "1.2.3.4", "ttl": 1, "proxied": true}; change: PATCH /zones/<zone>/dns_records/<id>; remove: DELETE .... Cache: POST /zones/<zone>/purge_cache {"purge_everything": true}. Settings: GET /zones/<zone>/settings, one: PATCH /zones/<zone>/settings/ssl {"value": "full"}. Analytics: GET /zones/<zone>/analytics/dashboard?since=-1440. Firewall rules: GET /zones/<zone>/firewall/rules; Workers: GET /accounts/<account>/workers/scripts. Tunnels: GET /accounts/<account>/cfd_tunnel. Every token has its own permissions: a 403 means the token lacks one. The token is set by Allkin.
